marriage.decree: I decree and declare by the right hand of the Lord — this covenant household is a legally established family jurisdiction, off-limits to every adversarial filing, right now, right now, right now by the blood of Jesus! By the outstretched hand of the Lord I command every spirit assigned to fracture what covenant has joined — division, comparison, silent withdrawal — to scatter by fire. I announce that this family stands back-to-back, governed by covenant, not by circumstance. By the finger of the Lord I write a new covenant of household unity, shared authority, and protected jurisdiction over this marriage and everyone under its roof. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
marriage.verdict: This household is a protected jurisdiction. Adversarial filings against it are inadmissible. Covenant governs the family.

marriage.position: A python does not attack a marriage head-on — it constricts, wrapping around communication and affection until the union can barely breathe. Naming the constriction breaks its grip.

marriage.decree: I decree and declare by the outstretched hand of the Lord — every python spirit of slow constriction wrapped around this marriage's communication, affection and trust LOOSES ITS GRIP right now, right now, right now by the blood of Jesus! By the strong arm of the LORD God of Hosts every gradual narrowing of connection, every squeeze that made distance feel normal — scatter by fire, scatter by fire! I announce breath and closeness are restored to this covenant union. By the finger of the Lord I write a new covenant of open communication, restored affection, and unhindered connection between covenant partners. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
marriage.verdict: The constriction on this marriage is broken. Breath and closeness are restored. The union is free to flourish.

marriage.position: Rehoboth was named after two seasons of contested wells — a household finally given room after strife had defined it for too long. A covenant marriage carries the same right to enlargement after contested seasons.

marriage.decree: I decree and declare by the right hand of the Lord — this marriage is called out of contested ground and into REHOBOTH right now, right now, right now! By the finger of the Lord every argument that dug the same well twice, every recurring conflict that never resolved — scatter by fire, scatter by fire! I announce that the Lord has made room for this covenant to be fruitful — room to grow together, room to build without contest defining every season. By the outstretched hand of the Lord I write a new covenant of enlarged trust, shared vision, and undisputed partnership. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
marriage.verdict: Rehoboth is declared over this marriage. The recurring strife is over. Room to grow together is legally granted.

health.position: You stand in the Courts of Heaven as one whose body is the temple of the Holy Spirit — a legal jurisdiction belonging to God, covered by covenant and sealed by the blood of Christ.

By the strong arm of the LORD God of Hosts I command every spirit of infirmity, every assignment of premature death, every devouring work in this body — scatter by fire, let the fire fall! Healing is a legal verdict already rendered at the cross and I enforce it now. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.

By the blood of Jesus I present the evidence: this body belongs to the Holy Spirit — it is legal temple territory — and no sickness, no infirmity and no generational disease holds lawful occupancy here. Right now, right now, right now by the outstretched hand of Yahweh Sabaoth I issue an EVICTION ORDER against every spirit of infirmity, every assignment of chronic illness, every legal claim of premature death — you are trespassing on covenant ground. By fire you are expelled. Catch Fire.

health.position: Sickness is not your portion — it is a legal claim answered and overturned at the cross. By the stripes of Jesus healing is not something you pray toward. It is something you enforce as a legal covenant right.

health.decree: I decree and declare by the outstretched hand of the Lord — every physical affliction, every chronic condition, every assignment of pain, weakness and disease is BROKEN right now, right now, right now by the blood of Jesus! By the whirlwind of the LORD God of Hosts I command every spirit of infirmity that has established residence in this body through trauma, bloodline access or spoken curse — scatter by fire, scatter by fire, let the fire fall! The stripes of Jesus are the legal receipt for my healing — PAID IN FULL — and I enforce that payment now. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
health.verdict: The payment has been made. Healing is legally purchased and enforced. Every infirmity is expelled by the evidence of the stripes.

health.decree: I announce by the finger of God — every hereditary disease, every generational sickness pattern, every bloodline legal claim of infirmity operating in this body is SEVERED right now, right now, right now by the blood of Jesus! identity.position: The shame narrative over your life is a fraudulent filing. It has no legal authority in the Courts of Heaven. The blood of Christ is the only record that stands — and that record declares you righteous, chosen, and fully covered.

identity.decree: I decree and declare by the strong arm of the Lord — every verdict of condemnation, every voice of accusation, every filing of shame and worthlessness that has operated against my identity is DISMISSED and OVERTURNED right now, right now, right now by the blood of Jesus! By the outstretched hand of Yahweh Sabaoth I command every accusing spirit, every religious assignment of unworthiness, every lie that has defined me outside of what the blood says — scatter by fire, let the fire fall! There is NO CONDEMNATION — that is a legal verdict not a feeling — and I enforce it now. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
identity.verdict: Condemnation is legally dismissed. The record reads: righteous, chosen, covered. No accusation has standing before this court.

identity.position: You were known before you were formed. Your identity was established in the heavenly courts before your first breath. No earthly verdict, no human opinion, and no adversarial filing can legally override what God authored.
identity.scripture: "I knew you before I formed you in your mother's womb. Before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as my prophet to the nations." — Jeremiah 1:5 NLT
identity.decree: I announce by the finger of God — my identity was ESTABLISHED BEFORE I WAS BORN and no earthly verdict can legally override heaven's original record. By the blood of Jesus I bring every lie, every label, every false name spoken over me before the Courts of Heaven and I move for EXPUNGEMENT right now, right now, right now! By the whirlwind of Yahweh Sabaoth I command every spirit operating through mistaken identity, every assignment of confusion about who I am — scatter by fire! I am who God said I was BEFORE THE FOUNDATION. That record stands. Catch Fire.
identity.verdict: The original heavenly record stands. Every false label is expunged. Identity is established before birth and confirmed by blood.

identity.position: You are not becoming — you already are. The version of you that legislators in the courts and the version of you that survived the wound are the same person. You bring all of yourself into the courtroom.
identity.scripture: "And I am certain that God, who began the good work within you, will continue his work until it is finally finished on the day when Christ Jesus returns." — Philippians 1:6 NLT
identity.decree: I take my full position before the Courts of Heaven — every part of me, every season I have walked through, every wound I survived — and I declare: the good work is NOT ABANDONED. By the blood of Jesus I present the evidence that God who began this work is legally obligated by covenant to complete it. Right now, right now, right now — by the right hand of Yahweh Sabaoth — I command every spirit of incompletion, every assignment of abandonment, every lie that says I am too broken to be used — scatter by fire! The work continues. The identity holds. Catch Fire.
identity.verdict: The good work continues. Incompletion has no legal standing. The covenant obligates completion and the blood enforces it.

identity.position: Righteousness itself was resurrected at the cross — not just forgiven, but raised to stand as your actual legal identity. This is the one place the resurrection is not a metaphor for warfare; it is the literal ground you stand on.

identity.decree: I decree and declare by the right hand of the Lord — by the resurrection power of Christ, righteousness itself was raised from the dead and seated as my legal identity right now, right now, right now! By the finger of the Lord every false name, every shame-label, every identity built on performance instead of the resurrected righteousness of Christ — scatter by fire, scatter by fire! I announce I am not improving toward righteousness; righteousness was raised and I am seated in it. By the outstretched hand of the Lord I write a new covenant of identity: not earned, not performed — resurrected and occupied. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.

identity.decree: I decree and declare by the outstretched hand of the Lord — every false identity propped up in place of who God says I am FALLS, and falls again if it is ever reset, right now, right now, right now by the blood of Jesus! In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.

I announce that the Lord has made room for me to grow into the fullness of who He named me. By the outstretched hand of the Lord I write a new covenant of expanding identity — room to become, room to be fully known. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.

restoration.position: You are not waiting for God to restore you — you are enforcing a restoration decree already rendered. As a Courts of Heaven advocate you have the authority to demand repayment from every adversarial force that has operated illegally.
restoration.scripture: "The thief's purpose is to steal and kill and destroy. My purpose is to give them a rich and satisfying life." — John 10:10 NLT
restoration.decree: I stand before the Courts of Heaven and I FILE a restoration demand against every thieving spirit that has operated illegally in my life. By the blood of Jesus I present the case: the thief was caught — and the law demands sevenfold repayment. Right now, right now, right now — by the right hand of Yahweh Sabaoth — I enforce that legal repayment over every stolen year, every seized resource, every relationship destroyed, every door illegally closed. I do not ask for restoration. I DEMAND it as a legal covenant right. Catch Fire.
restoration.verdict: The restoration demand is filed and granted. Sevenfold repayment is the legal ruling. Every stolen thing must be returned with interest.

restoration.position: Time itself can be redeemed by covenant. What the enemy stole in years of delay, loss, and wrong seasons is subject to legal restoration by the God who holds time as a legal jurisdiction.
restoration.scripture: "And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you." — Joel 2:25 KJV
restoration.decree: I announce by the finger of God — the YEARS the locust has eaten are legally subject to RESTORATION and I enforce that restoration right now! By the blood of Jesus I bring every stolen year, every season of loss, every decade of delay before the Courts of Heaven and I demand the legal return of what was consumed. Right now, right now, right now — by the outstretched hand of Yahweh Sabaoth — I command restoration of time, opportunity, health, relationships and resources stolen in every season — scatter every devourer by fire! The years are restored. The court rules in my favour. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
restoration.verdict: The stolen years are legally restored. Time, opportunity and resources consumed by the locust are returned by covenant mandate.

restoration.position: What was broken in your life was not God's design — it was an illegal filing by the adversary. Restoration is not returning you to where you were. It is positioning you where you were always legally meant to be.
restoration.scripture: "He restores my soul. He guides me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake." — Psalm 23:3 NKJV
restoration.decree: I decree and declare by the strong arm of the Lord — my soul is RESTORED, my path is REALIGNED and my destination is SECURED by the legal guidance of the Lord right now! By the blood of Jesus I present the evidence: the Good Shepherd restores and guides — that is a covenant obligation not a suggestion. Right now, right now, right now — by the whirlwind of Yahweh Sabaoth — I command every spirit of disorientation, every assignment that has pulled me off the covenant path — scatter by fire! I am not returning to where I was. I am arriving where I was always meant to be. Catch Fire.
restoration.verdict: The soul is restored. The path is realigned. Restoration positions you where you were always legally meant to be — not behind, ahead.

restoration.position: Restoration extends beyond what you personally lost. As a covenant heir you carry the legal right to decree restoration over your bloodline, your children, your community, and every sphere assigned to your jurisdictional authority.
restoration.scripture: "Restore our fortunes, LORD, as streams renew the desert." — Psalm 126:4 NLT
restoration.decree: I take my full position as a Courts of Heaven advocate and I DECREE restoration — not just over my life but over my bloodline, my children, my community and every sphere legally assigned to my jurisdiction. By the blood of Jesus I file a comprehensive restoration decree: every fortune seized, every stream dried up, every covenant resource withheld across my entire jurisdictional assignment is RELEASED right now, right now, right now by fire! By the right hand of Yahweh Sabaoth let streams of restoration renew every desert season in my sphere. Scatter every withholding spirit by fire! Catch Fire.
restoration.verdict: Comprehensive restoration is filed. Streams renew every desert. The decree extends across every sphere of jurisdictional authority.

restoration.position: Restoration is not recovery of the old — it is resurrection of what was actually righteous and lost. The resurrection power of Christ does not patch up what died; it raises it new.
restoration.scripture: "If the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit." — Romans 8:11 ESV
restoration.decree: I decree and declare by the right hand of the Lord — by the resurrection power of Christ, everything righteous that this season declared dead is RAISED, not patched, right now, right now, right now! By the finger of the Lord every spirit that tried to offer me a recovered version of what I lost instead of the resurrected fullness — scatter by fire, scatter by fire! I announce I am not settling for restored fragments; the same power that raised Christ is raising what was righteously mine. By the outstretched hand of the Lord I receive resurrection, not recovery. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
restoration.verdict: What was righteous is resurrected, not merely recovered. The fullness is raised, not patched together.

restoration.position: Whatever stole your years and inheritance set itself up as an idol in territory it never legally owned. It falls the way every false claim falls in this court — and the restoration follows the fall.
restoration.scripture: "But when the citizens of Ashdod went to see it the next morning, Dagon had fallen with his face to the ground in front of the Ark of the Lord!" — 1 Samuel 5:3-4 NLT
restoration.decree: I decree and declare by the outstretched hand of the Lord — every false claim that stole years, resources and seasons from my life FALLS before this covenant right now, right now, right now by the blood of Jesus! By the finger of the Lord the thief's idol of ownership over what it stole — break at the neck and hands like Dagon and scatter by fire. I announce a fallen claim has no legal right to what it once held; restitution follows the fall. By the strong arm of the LORD God of Hosts I write a new covenant of sevenfold return over everything the fallen claim once occupied. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
restoration.verdict: The false claim over your stolen years has fallen. Restitution legally follows the fall — sevenfold return is granted.

restoration.position: Rehoboth is, at its root, a restoration decree — God made room after seasons of contested loss and named the room itself as proof of fruitfulness to come. Restoration and enlargement are the same covenant word.
restoration.scripture: "He called its name Rehoboth, saying, 'For now the LORD has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.'" — Genesis 26:22 ESV
restoration.decree: I decree and declare by the right hand of the Lord — my restoration is called REHOBOTH right now, right now, right now — room made, fruit guaranteed, by the blood of Jesus! By the finger of the Lord every season of contested loss, every well dug and disputed before this one, is closed — scatter by fire, scatter by fire! I announce the Lord has made room, and room made by the Lord is never given without fruit attached. By the outstretched hand of the Lord I write a new covenant: restoration is not partial return, it is Rehoboth — full room, full fruitfulness. In the name of Yahweh Sabaoth — Catch Fire.
restoration.verdict: Restoration is declared as Rehoboth — room made and fruit guaranteed. The contested loss is closed permanently.
